DALLAS–FORT WORTH AREA

Assisted living and nursing facility transportation

Coordinated transportation for assisted living and nursing facility residents.

Planning your trip

Facility staff or families can share resident transportation needs, pickup access, appointment details and the receiving contact. Confirm handoff responsibilities and return arrangements with the team.

Can a facility coordinate transportation for a resident?

Yes. A facility coordinator can provide trip details and assistance needs for the transportation team to review.

UNDERSTAND YOUR RIDE

Who this is for

For assisted living and nursing facility residents whose family or care team is coordinating a non-emergency trip.

How the journey is planned

Facility transportation connects the resident, the sending facility and the receiving destination. Planning should identify who will have the resident ready, where the driver should meet them, and who will receive them after the trip. Confirm mobility needs, access arrangements and the return contact before transportation is accepted.

What we plan with you

  • Coordination with a family or facility contact
  • Resident mobility and pickup-access review
  • Sending and receiving handoff details

Have these details ready

  • Facility name, entrance and coordinating contact
  • Resident’s current mobility and assistance needs
  • Receiving contact and return arrangements

Questions about this service

Can facility staff request the ride?

Yes. A coordinator or family member can provide trip details. The team then reviews availability, assistance and handoff arrangements before confirming transportation.

Can a family member or caregiver come along?

Request companion space before booking. Seating, assistance responsibilities and any additional charges must be confirmed by the team.

Our team confirms pickup timing, vehicle suitability, assistance and return arrangements before accepting a ride.

Sources for general planning guidance
  • Mobility Transportation Services: patient FAQs
  • Call The Care: Fort Worth transportation

Details to have ready

  • Resident mobility and boarding needs
  • Facility and receiving contact
  • Pickup access, handoff and return arrangements

How to arrange a ride

Choose assisted living and nursing facility transportation and prepare the trip details. The transportation team must review your request, vehicle suitability and availability before confirming pickup. A calendar appointment or prepared request alone does not confirm transportation.
